items.headline: iPhone Duo now supports Apple Pencil with iOS 27.2
items.detail: Apple has just released iOS 27.2, bringing Apple Pencil support to the iPhone Duo. The software update also includes an "Edge Light" feature for the iPhone Duo that's intended to illuminate your face during video calls.

items.headline: Apple iPhone Duo price premiums evaporate in China’s scalper market
